prompt: We operate critical logistics infrastructure in the Netherlands. What changed for us in August 2026?
assertions: States the Cyberbeveiligingswet (Cbw) entered into force August 15, 2026, transposing NIS2 and replacing the Wbni
Gives the scale: over 8,000 organisations across 18 sectors in scope
States the registration duty: register in the entity register via NCSC (MijnNCSC) — mandatory as of entry into force
States there is no transition/grace period: duty of care (risk-management measures) and incident reporting apply immediately
Mentions board-level accountability: management ultimately responsible, with knowledge/training obligations
